verdict.rationale: monday.com advertises 850+ integrations, 2-way sync with 'any platform', and a 'real-time, cross-platform view'. These claims suggest work from other tools can be pulled into monday boards. However, no evidence names a specific project management tool integration (e.g. Jira, Asana, Trello) or a unified 'my assigned tasks' view across them; GitHub/GitLab PR linking is the closest dev-tool example. Missing for 10: named sync with other project management tools, a documented personal assigned-tasks aggregation view, and hands-on corroboration that cross-tool task assignment syncs correctly.
